text: [63] yekeci bhikkhave mayi niṭṭhaṃgatā sabbe te diṭṭhisampannā [1] pañcannaṃ idha niṭṭhā pañcannaṃ idha vihāya niṭṭhā katamesaṃ pañcannaṃ idha niṭṭhā sattakkhattataparamassa 2 kolaṃkolassa ekabījissa sakadāgāmissa yo ca diṭṭheva dhamme arahā imesaṃ pañcannaṃ idha niṭṭhā katamesaṃ pañcannaṃ idha vihāya niṭṭhā antarāparinibbāyissa upahaccaparinibbāyissa asaṅkhāraparinibbāyissa sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyissa uddhaṃsotassa akaniṭṭhagāmino imesaṃ pañcannaṃ idha vihāya niṭṭhā yekeci #1 ma. yu. tesaṃ diṭṭhisampannānanti atthi . 2 ma. yu. sattakkhattuparamassa . #sabbatthāpi īdisameva . bhikkhave mayi niṭṭhaṃgatā sabbe te diṭṭhisampannā tesaṃ diṭṭhisampannānaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ idha niṭṭhā imesaṃ pañcannaṃ idha vihāya niṭṭhāti .
